Publish.LongDescription:
# Advanced Building & Asset Manager (BAM)
**Advanced Building & Asset Manager (BAM)** gives city builders complete real-time visibility and control over every placed building, company, municipal service facility, sub-building upgrade, district, and catalog prefab in **Cities: Skylines II**.
Open BAM anytime using the top-left **BAM** toolbar button or the **BAM** quick-inspect button on any vanilla Building or District info panel.
## Key Features
### 1. 10-Tab Building & Catalog Explorer - **Dedicated Category Views**: Tailored tables, summary strips, and **Zone Matrices** (Residential, Commercial, Office, Industrial, Storage, Services & Signature) for **All Buildings**, **Districts**, **Residential**, **Commercial**, **Industrial**, **Office**, **Storage**, **Civic Services**, **Signature Landmarks**, and **Catalog Prefabs**. - **Customizable & Reorderable Columns**: Resize, show/hide, and reorder table columns independently per category tab, with synchronized horizontal scrolling and double-click width reset. - **Quick Presets & Favorites**: 1-click triage pills for **Favorites**, **Damaged**, **Turned Off**, **Needs Repair**, **Abandoned**, **Losing Money**, **At Capacity**, **High Wealth**, and **Mixed-Use**, plus building and prefab starring. - **Free-Floating Draggable Filters Flyout**: Filter by **Lot Width x Depth**, **Corner Type** (Straight, Left, Right), **Building Level** (L1-L5), **Zone Type & Density**, **Parking**, **Resources**, **Transit Hubs**, **Service Category**, **Theme**, and **Creator Pack / DLC**, with interactive **Active Filter Chips**.
### 2. 12-Card Draggable Building Inspector & Sub-Building Upgrades Expand any building or catalog row to inspect 12 reorderable, collapsible detail cards: - **Identity, Specs & Supply Chain**: Entity ID, street address, prefab name, district, theme/DLC badge, construction cost, lot footprint, land value, foot traffic, input/output goods, and warehouse storage utilization. - **Performance, Economics & Services**: Workforce by education tier, efficiency, utilities, crime risk, monthly maintenance, company profitability, tax rate, household wealth tier, income, rent, upkeep, utility fees, school enrollment, parking occupancy, and park attractiveness. - **Efficiency & Citizen Happiness**: Live breakdown of building efficiency modifiers and all 26 household/worker happiness factors. - **Sub-Building Upgrades & Radius Effects**: Inspect attached service extensions with 1-click camera focus, toggle on/off, repair, or demolish, plus active city-wide modifiers and local radius auras.
### 3. Interactive District & City-Wide Analytics Dashboard - **Game-Authoritative City Snapshot**: Live ECS rollup of **All Citizens**, **Moved-In Residents**, **Employed Workers**, **Students**, **Tourists**, **Commuters**, **Moving Away**, and **Homeless**. - **9 Draggable Dashboard Cards**: **Citizen Happiness Factors**, **Demographics** (Age Groups & Resident Education mini-bars, Residents, Students, Tourists, Homeless), **Workforce & Jobs** (Worker Education vs Workplace Capacity, Open Positions, Unemployment), **Housing & Zoning** (Zone breakdown, Households/Cap, Wealth tier, Income, Rent, Upkeep, Resource Cost, Service Fees, Pets, Commercial Sales), **Schools & Education** (Elementary, High School, College, University Enrolled vs Capacity & Eligibility), **Utilities & Services**, **Land, Health & Safety** (Area, Land Value, Attractiveness, Sick Citizens, Crime, Pollution), **City & District Policies**, and **Policy Plus**. - **Ordinance & Policy Plus Controls**: Toggle native ordinances and **Policy Plus** policies with sliders, conflict prevention, **Apply to All Districts**, and **Copy Policies**.
### 4. City Tools, Emergency Repairs, Plopping & Vanilla Integration - **1-Click Emergency Repairs**: Restore individual buildings or run city-wide ECS recovery actions (**Repair All Buildings**, **Extinguish Fires** including extractors, **Drain Floods**, **Storm Recovery**, **Clear Accidents** including roads & vehicles, **Rebuild Collapsed**, **Reclaim Abandoned**, and **Fix Broken Paths** via automated in-place Move/Relocate for buildings with broken road or pedestrian access). - **Direct Prefab Plopping & Cloning**: Plop any standalone catalog building prefab or clone existing placed buildings with 1 click. - **Vanilla SIP, Scene Explorer, Persistent Settings & 11 Languages**: Native **BAM** quick-inspect button on Building & District info panels, **Scene Explorer** entity ID click inspection, file-backed UI settings persistence (`ModsSettings/AdvancedBAM/ui-settings.json`), Docked Maximize, CSV Data Export, and 11-language localization (EN, DE, ES, FR, IT, JA, KO, PL, PT-BR, RU, ZH-HANS).

ChangeLog.Value: Update v1.0.2: Added automated in-place Move/Relocate path repair for buildings with broken pedestrian/road access (single-row Path button, Broken Path status badge, Fix Path inspector button, and Fix Broken Paths / Repair All bulk tools, including upgraded service buildings); exact vanilla city/district population, homeless & sub-building worker parity; fixed background catalog warmup timing for Asset Icon Library thumbnails & Filters Flyout pack list; added inline asset renaming in expanded Identity & Location; added Storage Totals column on Storage, Service Fleet column after Usage on Services, City-Wide & Unassigned rows in Zone Matrices + Explorer filter, Damaged % badges across all tabs, name-only search, Quick Presets hide button, ghost-free Favorites tracking, and full Burst AOT release packaging.
